name: aicad-agent
description: Agent-native tools for deterministic 2D/3D CAD, calibrated reference reconstruction, and audited host workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Review and modify constrained 2D/3D CAD through one agent-native workflow.
interface.longDescription: Select geometry or parameters, read exact model measurements, toggle MODEL_XYZ, describe changes in plain language, inspect arbitrary sections, and export one source-bound modification request. Review HTML is persisted by content hash; automated tools do not open tabs unless auto/always is explicitly requested. Protocol-4 native dimensions, exact transactions, dependency replay, host authority boundaries, production gates and audit evidence remain enforced internally.
capabilities: Automatic post-build review launch with safe headless fallback
Construction-stage axis, sheet and furniture component gates
Precompile architectural axes, room equipment, dimension-purpose and door-topology contract
Protocol-4 native DIMENSION with purpose/style XData
defaultPrompt: Open the CAD modifier so I can click a line, point, or circle and inspect its exact model values.
Rebuild this webpage drawing as calibrated 1:1 CAD with matching annotations.
Use the plugin to draw a 120x80 mm plate with a centered 20 mm hole.
